questions.question_text: Which two controls can limit access to an Azure Storage account? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.text: Network rules and virtual network endpoints

questions.explanation: Storage firewalls restrict source networks and SAS tokens provide scoped, time-limited access. Route tables and management groups do not grant or restrict Storage data access.

questions.question_text: A partner needs temporary read access to one Blob container without storage account keys. Which option should you choose?

question_data.scenario: The partner needs read-only access for five days. Access must be revocable and scoped to a single container. The company does not want to create an Entra account for the partner.
question_data.instructions: Read the scenario, then select the best answer.

options.label: A
options.text: A user delegation SAS scoped to the container

options.label: C
options.text: Public access on the storage account

options.label: D
options.text: A resource lock on the container

questions.explanation: A user delegation SAS provides time-limited delegated access to a container and can be revoked. Account keys are too broad, public access is not scoped, and locks do not grant access.

questions.question_text: Order the steps to generate a SAS token for a Blob container with CLI.

question_data.instructions: Place the items in the correct order.

options.label: A
options.text: Create or select a storage account

options.label: D
options.text: Use the SAS URI within its expiry

questions.explanation: The storage account and container must exist before generating a SAS token, which is then used before it expires.

questions.question_text: Which option provides private IP-based access from the virtual network to the storage account?

question_data.instructions: Click the correct area of the diagram.

questions.explanation: A private endpoint maps the storage service to a private IP address in the virtual network, so traffic uses the private address space.

questions.question_text: Which option keeps storage traffic on the Azure backbone while the account still uses a public endpoint?

question_data.instructions: Click the correct area of the diagram.

questions.explanation: A service endpoint secures storage access over the Azure backbone but does not assign a private IP address to the storage account.
